old_test = 'tests/governance/result-counts.test.mjs'

runners = ['infra/acceptance/run.mjs', 'infra/runtime/run.mjs']
paths = [old_test, parser, *runners] + ([new_test] if a.mode == 'after' else [])
originals = {path: (root / path).read_bytes() for path in paths}
sha = lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
summary = {'mode': a.mode, 'root': str(root), 'node': a.node,
           'sourceSHA256': {path: sha(data) for path, data in originals.items()}, 'runs': []}

def save_summary():
    (out / 'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')

def command(label, cwd, tests, expected):
    args = [a.node, '--test', '--test-reporter=tap', *tests]
    start = time.time()
    result = subprocess.run(args, cwd=cwd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=120)
    (out / (label + '.stdout')).write_bytes(result.stdout)
    (out / (label + '.stderr')).write_bytes(result.stderr)
    summary['runs'].append({'label': label, 'argv': args, 'cwd': str(cwd),
                            'exitCode': result.returncode, 'expectedExitCode': expected,
                            'elapsedSeconds': time.time() - start})
    save_summary()
    if result.returncode != expected:
        raise RuntimeError(f'{label}: exit {result.returncode}, expected {expected}; inspect preserved logs')
    if expected == 1:
        text = result.stdout.decode()
        if 'published counts must equal the independent report fixture' not in text:
            raise RuntimeError(f'{label}: not the intended actual publication counter assertion')
        if '# fail 1' not in text or '# pass 4' not in text:
            raise RuntimeError(f'{label}: expected exactly one failed and four passed top-level tests')

def copy_source(label):

    directory.mkdir(parents=True)
    for path, data in originals.items():
        target = directory / path
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_bytes(data)
    os.symlink(root / 'node_modules', directory / 'node_modules', target_is_directory=True)
    return directory
